guides.title: Study 1 Chronicles
guides.description: Follow selected chapters through the book.

steps.title: From Adam to Israel and Edom
steps.text: The family lists begin with Adam, Noah, and Abraham. They include Israel’s ancestors, neighboring peoples, and Edom’s rulers. Israel’s family belongs within a larger human family. The book remembers neighbors as well as its own ancestors.

steps.title: Levites carry the ark with music
steps.text: David prepares a tent and appoints priests, Levites, singers, and gatekeepers. They carry the ark to Jerusalem. Michal watches from a window. Levites carry the ark as Moses taught. David changes how he brings it to Jerusalem.

steps.title: Gifts, prayer, a new king, and David's death
steps.text: David and the leaders give for the temple. David thanks God, and Solomon becomes king. The book closes with David’s death. David says their wealth first came from God. Giving returns part of what they received.
